clues: This capital city sits on the north-west coast of a large island in the South Pacific. It is the largest city of its small island nation.
The rains fall most from late fall to spring, when the wet winds blow. In 2010, this town saw the most high heat in its past.
In 1942, troops from the United States and Japan fought for an airfield just east of this city. The United States won that fierce battle.
By 2003, unrest here had grown so bad that the rulers asked many Pacific lands to step in. Their joint force came to bring back calm and order.
The house of laws, the state museum, and a big market all stand in this chief town of the isles.
